eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 29 · TempDB & Memory Tuning

eyebrow: The symptom: latches, not disk waits
code:
SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count,
       wait_time_ms, signal_wait_time_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type LIKE 'PAGELATCH%';

-- PAGELATCH_UP / PAGELATCH_EX
-- page already IN MEMORY —
-- sessions contending to access it
caption: Different animal from PAGEIOLATCH (a physical disk read).

eyebrow: The pages that get hot under concurrency
code:
GAM   which extents are allocated at all
SGAM  which mixed extents have free space
PFS   how full each individual page is

Many sessions creating/dropping temp
objects converge on the SAME few
bookkeeping pages.
caption: One GAM/PFS page covers a huge range of data pages.

eyebrow: The fix: multiple, EQUALLY sized files
code:
ALTER DATABASE tempdb ADD FILE (
    NAME = tempdev2,
    FILENAME = 'D:\TempDB\tempdb2.ndf',
    SIZE = 8192MB,
    FILEGROWTH = 512MB
);
-- repeat, same SIZE + FILEGROWTH
-- ~1 file per core, up to ~8
caption: Unequal sizes defeat it — proportional fill favors the emptiest file.
